svg.title: Recipe install flow
svg.desc: Running mx add site with the astro recipe loads that recipe's manifest, resolves its options and expands its placeholders, optionally runs the recipe's init command to scaffold the framework app and create the declared directories, renders the template files into the project as the app source, the compose baseline and dev override, the dockerfiles and the service env file, writes Traefik routing labels for the chosen domain, and prints next steps ending in make dev, which brings the service up behind the router.
